prompt:
[Original Poem Line]: Enter a classic poem line with clear emotion and imagery
[Two-character Theme]: Extract 2 core characters from the poem
[Core Emotion]: Endless flowing / inextricable / unforgettable / cannot stay / waiting / yearning, etc.
[Emotional Action]: Flowing away / entangling / remaining / disappearing / fading / drifting away, etc.
[Minor Subject]: Water traces / threads / old windows / flower petals / lanterns / boats / letters, etc.
